verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same flaws. The wind-turbine icon, which is the original's hero image, has shrunk to a tiny unreadable mark at the top. The coloured triangles are squeezed into a small row of fragments across the top edge, with stray line segments scattered around them. The headline wraps into an oversized four-line block with no balance. The decorative lines on the right crowd the ends of 'SUMMIT' and 'MARCH 18', and there is dead space at the bottom.
